finalCta.paragraph: The M166 is a range of naturally aspirated inline-four petrol engines produced by Mercedes-Benz from 1997 to 2005. It features a transversely mounted aluminium alloy block and cylinder head with SOHC valvetrain (2 valves per cylinder) and multipoint fuel injection. The engine was used in the W168 A-Class and W414 Vaneo.
